# Vendored

`ical.min.js` is [ical.js](https://github.com/kewisch/ical.js) 2.2.1, the ES5
build (`dist/ical.es5.min.cjs` from the npm package), unmodified. It reads
iCalendar files and expands repeating events. Mozilla Public License 2.0 —
the licence notice is at the top of the file, and the source is at the link
above. It is loaded only once a calendar is connected.
